description: Source code for the switch channel finite state machine (FSM) and task management in the prplMesh project. Implements FSM states, event handling, and communication for channel switching, including request loading, notifications, and timeout handling.

classes.name: SwitchChannelFsm
classes.description: Finite State Machine managing the switch channel process, handling requests, notifications, timeouts, and reporting.

classes.name: SwitchChannelTask
classes.description: Task managing multiple FSM instances for different interfaces, handling events and periodic work.

methods.name: load_switch_channel_request_to_cmdu_tx
methods.description: Loads a switch channel request into a CMDU message for transmission.

methods.name: SwitchChannelFsm::SwitchChannelFsm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FSM with interface name, task pool, backhaul manager, and CMDU message.

methods.name: SwitchChannelFsm::config_fsm
methods.description: Configures the FSM states and transitions for channel switching.

methods.name: SwitchChannelFsm::report_switch_channel_in_progress
methods.description: Handles reporting when a switch channel is already in progress.

methods.name: SwitchChannelTask::get_fsm_by_ifname
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an FSM instance for a given interface name.

methods.name: SwitchChannelTask::work
methods.description: Periodically triggers FSMs to handle periodic events.

methods.name: SwitchChannelTask::handle_event
methods.description: Handles incoming events and dispatches them to the appropriate FSM.
